snippet.title: Chaos Rings Omega ~ Part 13
snippet.description:
Chaos Rings Omega (ケイオスリングス オメガ) is a role-playing video and a prequel to Chaos Rings.


Developer(s): Media.Vision
Publisher(s): Square Enix
Platform(s): iOS, Android, Playstation Vita
Release: May 19 2011
Genre(s): Role-playing
Language: English
Played on Playstation Vita TV
